params.name: Expression pedal
params.desc: Morphs between toe up and toe down knob settings

params.name: Space decay
params.desc: Sets decay energy of the reverberation space

params.name: Modulate
params.desc: Sets overall modulation depth of the reverb algorithm

params.name: Mix
params.desc: Adjusts mix of dry and wet signals in analog domain

params.name: Lo frequency
params.desc: Changes low frequency decay times in the reverb algorithm

params.name: Hi frequency
params.desc: Changes high frequency absorption in the reverb algorithm

params.name: Predelay
params.desc: Sets amount of time that elapses before the onset of reverberation

params.name: Mod speed
params.desc: Sets dominant modulation speed of the reverb algorithm

params.name: Pitch vector mix
params.desc: Adjusts mix between intra-tank pitch shifted reflections and normal reflections

params.name: Density
params.desc: Sets amount of initial build up of echoes before the reverb tank

params.name: Attack time
params.desc: Sets the attack time for the swell envelope

params.name: Vibrato depth
params.desc: Adds vibrato to the reverb input

params.name: Swell
params.desc: Engages auto swell function or maximizes space decay sustain when held
